def solution():
    # Define variables
    prices = [
        120, 122, 121, 124, 125,
        127, 126, 129, 130, 128,
        131, 132, 134, 135, 137,
        136, 138, 139, 140, 142,
        141, 143, 144, 146, 145
    ]
    period_ema = 10
    period_atr = 10
    multiplier = 1.5

    # Calculate the 10-day EMA
    ema = [sum(prices[:period_ema]) / period_ema]
    ema_multiplier = 2 / (period_ema + 1)

    for price in prices[period_ema:]:
        ema.append(
            (price - ema[-1]) * ema_multiplier + ema[-1]
        )

    # Calculate the 10-day ATR using consecutive price ranges
    true_ranges = [
        abs(prices[i] - prices[i - 1])
        for i in range(1, len(prices))
    ]

    atr = [sum(true_ranges[:period_atr]) / period_atr]

    for true_range in true_ranges[period_atr:]:
        atr.append(
            (atr[-1] * (period_atr - 1) + true_range) / period_atr
        )

    # Align EMA and ATR series
    if len(ema) > len(atr):
        ema = ema[-len(atr):]
    elif len(atr) > len(ema):
        atr = atr[-len(ema):]

    # Calculate the final upper Keltner Channel band
    last_upper_band = ema[-1] + multiplier * atr[-1]

    # Return the answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(last_upper_band, 2)
